scope: Fixed held-out threshold matrix; interleaved independent old/new processes, NOT same-process A/B. No compilation or parameter search inside script.
binary_source_correspondence: Each before/after binary hash and source label independently matched the respective saved build report, whose five source hashes were checked against its fixed Git commit. Labels alone are not treated as proof.

timing_scope.merged_csvs: Concatenations of raw per-cell CSVs, not additional observations.

integrity_notes: 391 transferred raw files verified; each process exit and log hash checked, 48 validation JSON hashes checked, 6 merged CSV hashes checked. Script hash matches execution summary. Both analysis directories copied without filtering. Repeated API and host selfchecks are not new coverage.

privacy_review.notes: Project/SDK paths, vendor compiler build path, binary provenance hashes and run conditions retained. No binaries, SDK header implementations or rental receipts copied. Pattern review is not a universal secret-detection guarantee.

unit_conversion.scope: Derived summary tables only; original method_summary.csv files and raw observations unchanged.
unit_conversion.conversion: Every *_us time column is divided by 1000 exactly in decimal and renamed *_ms. Other fields, column order and row order preserved.
unit_conversion.verification: All nonempty time cells checked by exact rational arithmetic; other cell strings and header order matched.
